name: Smitacs Transaction Gateway for PPOB
author: smitacs

sections.description:
Smitacs Transaction Gateway for PPOB is a WordPress plugin that allows administrators to manage PPOB (Payment Point Online Bank) transactions directly from the WordPress dashboard.

Plugin ini dirancang khusus untuk digunakan di Indonesia dan mendukung berbagai layanan pembayaran digital yang umum digunakan.

The plugin connects WordPress to an external PPOB API to perform balance inquiries, product listings, customer inquiries, payment processing, and transaction monitoring.

Supported Services (Indonesia Only)

Plugin ini hanya mendukung layanan PPOB yang tersedia di Indonesia, antara lain:

  • Pembayaran listrik PLN (pascabayar)
  • Pembelian token listrik PLN (prabayar)
  • Pembayaran PDAM
  • Pembayaran Pajak Bumi dan Bangunan (PBB)
  • Pembelian pulsa (all operator)
  • Paket data internet
  • Top up e-money / e-wallet (e-toll, dll)
  • Layanan digital lainnya sesuai provider PPOB
  • (Optional) Tiket pesawat (jika didukung API)

Important Note

This plugin is intended for use in Indonesia only, as it relies on local PPOB services and providers.

This plugin is designed for businesses, agents, or resellers who already have valid access credentials to a PPOB service provider.

Features

  • PPOB product listing (produk otomatis dari API)
  • Customer inquiry (cek ID pelanggan)
  • PPOB payment processing (real-time)
  • Transaction history and status checking
  • Balance and deposit monitoring
  • Secure API-based communication (HMAC & token)
  • Integration with WordPress user system

Configuration

You must have a valid PPOB API account from the provider.

Required configuration:
* API Base URL
* API Key / Token
* Secret Key (if required)

Without API activation, the plugin will not function.

External Services

This plugin connects to an external PPOB API service operated by Visionomic Journal.

Service Name: Simolawp PPOB API
Service URL: https://api.simolawp.com/api

Purpose:
The external service is required to:
– Retrieve PPOB product listings
– Perform customer inquiries
– Process PPOB payments
– Check transaction status
– Synchronize account balance
– Record transaction logs for reporting purposes

Data Sent:
When performing transactions, the following data is transmitted to the external API:

  • API Key
  • Secret Key
  • Timestamp
  • HMAC Signature
  • WordPress User ID
  • Username
  • User role
  • Transaction reference number
  • Product code
  • Customer ID (ID Pelanggan)
  • Transaction amount

When Data is Sent:
– During product synchronization
– During customer inquiries
– When processing payments
– When checking transaction status
– When synchronizing balance

Data is transmitted securely over HTTPS.

No personal data is transmitted automatically without user-initiated transaction actions.

Terms of Service:
https://api.simolawp.com/terms-and-condition

Privacy Policy:
https://api.simolawp.com/privacy-policy-2
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder smitacs-ppob-gateway to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to PPOB Settings in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Enter your PPOB API credentials and API endpoint URL.
  5. Save settings and start using the plugin.
